title: Software Engineer - Core Finance
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

As a Software Engineer, Applications Engineering, your role will be to architect, design, develop, and build robust technology solutions that scale the Record\-to\-Report (R2R), Fixed Assets, Cash Management, and Projects processes and related systems. This involves close collaboration with teams across Business Transformation, Enterprise Architecture, Application Engineering, Application Product Management, Docusign Product, Data, and Integration teams.  

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director of Enterprise Applications, Finance.  

**Responsibility**
* Streamline financial decision\-making and operational efficiency by conducting thorough analysis of complex business problems, creating end\-to\-end process and system flow diagrams, and prototyping solution options
* Ensure seamless financial close cycles and overall system health by applying techno\-functional expertise across General Ledger (GL), Fixed Assets (FA), and Projects domains, providing operational oversight, L3 issue resolution, and system stability
* Automate financial document processing, journal entries, and intelligent classification within R2R and General Ledger workflows by engineering AI/ML pipelines, automated workflows, and leveraging Oracle's agentic Al framework to build scalable solutions
* Strengthen internal controls and enhance fraud detection across General Ledger (GL), Subledger Accounting (SLA), and Fixed Assets (FA) systems through predictive modeling and Al\-driven anomaly detection frameworks
* Deliver intelligent conversational insights and predictive financial forecasting to leadership by leveraging GenAI, LLMS, RAG frameworks, Agentic Al, and MLOps
* Enable scalable financial operations and resilient accounting patterns by taking ownership of technical designs and functional configurations across Oracle Cloud ERP modules, specifically Fixed Assets (FA), Projects, GL, Cash Management, and SLA
* Facilitate real\-time financial data flow across enterprise platforms by implementing high\-throughput inbound and outbound integrations via Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP APIs, and FBDI
* Maintain uninterrupted financial processing and data accuracy during peak volumes by establishing robust observability frameworks, automated retry mechanisms, and idempotency controls
* Maximize operational uptime and release agility for core ERP systems by automating routine operational tasks (batch scheduling, data refreshes) through standardized CI/CD pipelines
* Ensure SOX compliance and audit readiness by partnering with security teams to enforce role\-based access models and strict segregation\-of\-duties (SOD) rules
* Maintain financial close\-window SLAs strictly by performing performance engineering and query optimization for high\-volume GL, SLA, and Fixed Assets interfaces
* Address unique business process needs while keeping technical debt low by building custom extensions (PL/SQL, Java/Groovy, VBCS/OCI) to rigorous standards
* Fulfill complex accounting requirements efficiently by applying standard Oracle capabilities (SLA, BI Publisher, OTBI, workflows) rather than building redundant custom code
* Protect cash flow visibility and secure bank interactions by defining technical specifications for Treasury and Cash Management interfaces
* Drive continuous business functionality from discovery through support by leading the end\-to\-end R2R delivery lifecycle
* Empower executive finance stakeholders with actionable insights by designing, developing, and maintaining custom BI Publisher (BIP) reports, OTBI dashboards, and embedded analytics

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

  

  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**
* BS/BA degree or equivalent
* 5\+ years of experience in Fusion Financials with 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in finance software engineering, specifically within the Record\-to\-Report (R2R) track
* Experience as a techno\-functional software engineer in the Core Finance domain, specializing in Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CE), Project Costing, Subledger Accounting (SLA), and General Ledger (GL)
* Experience with the functional configuration and setup of core Oracle Finance modules (GL, FA, Cash Management, Project Costing, SLA) to support business processes
* Experience developing and maintaining BI Publisher (BIP) reports, custom financial reporting, and complex data models
* Experience with Java and modern development frameworks to design and extend finance integrations and applications
* Experience building and deploying enterprise AI/ML solutions, LLMS, RAG architectures, and Agentic Al workflows to drive automated financial processing and insights
* Experience developing and tuning complex SQL and PL/SQL code to optimize reports, data extensions, and high\-volume processing logic
* Experience engineering system robustness and reliability, utilizing observability, automated error handling, idempotency, and data reconciliation techniques in high\-volume environments
* Experience ensuring all technical solutions adhere to SOX, auditability, and organizational security requirements
* Experience managing the full development lifecycle, from initial requirements discovery and solution architecture through to deployment and ongoing production support

**Preferred**
* Strong analytical and debugging skills to resolve complex issues across custom configurations and integrations, while effectively communicating technical insights to finance stakeholders
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for enterprise\-grade application and data integrations
* Experience supporting post\-Go Live Oracle Cloud Applications and stabilizing core financial integrations
* Solid understanding of Intercompany, Accounts Payable (AP), and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) processes and accounting workflows
* Expertise in building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines, scripting migrations, and automating tests for Oracle Cloud ERP artifacts such as reports, integrations, and configurations
* Familiarity with integrating ERP systems with financial reporting tools, reconciliation platforms, and tax engines
* Professional background in global technology or SaaS environments, with experience supporting multiple ledgers, currencies, and localizations
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace for technical documentation, data analysis, and presentations
* Foundational understanding of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services and architecture concepts
* Hands\-on experience using Jira and Confluence for agile backlog management, sprint planning, and technical documentation

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  

  

  

**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.  

**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office.**

**Senior Accountant**


From accounting and financial planning to risk/fraud analysis and payments, our Finance team ensures not only our company’s financial security, but that our customers can buy from us with confidence. Priceline.com – a part of Booking Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $130 billion – is looking for a Senior Accountant to join its Accounting team.

**Why this job’s a big deal:**


As a key member of Priceline’s General Ledger Accounting team, this Senior Accountant will ensure the accurate and timely preparation of journal entries and account reconciliations while owning core intercompany accounting activities across Booking Holdings brands, including monthly recording, reconciliation, settlement, reporting, and eliminations.


The ideal candidate will bring strong technical accounting judgment, experience handling intercompany accounting across multiple entities and currencies, and disciplined close execution. They will also have the communication skills and business acumen to partner effectively with teams across Priceline and Booking Holdings, safeguard internal controls, and identify opportunities to improve and automate processes.

**In this role you will get to:**

* Own the monthly intercompany close process for assigned entities, including journal entries, reconciliations, confirmations, settlement, reporting, and elimination support.
* Partner with accounting teams across all Booking Holdings’ brands to ensure intercompany elimination activities are completed accurately and in accordance with the monthly close timeline.
* Exhibit a detailed understanding of all intercompany relationships, including but not limited to revenue share and cost\-plus arrangements.
* Maintain and monitor that internal controls are effectively operating for assigned tasks and identify enhancements where gaps are identified.
* Ensure intercompany activity is recorded in accordance with US GAAP, internal accounting policies, and the applicable intercompany agreements.
* Support implementation and ongoing optimization of the BlackLine Intercompany module, including testing, process documentation, controls, and issue resolution.
* Prepare monthly journal entries primarily for intercompany transactions, along with other related tasks
* Prepare monthly reconciliations for assigned balance sheet accounts; investigate and resolve reconciling items, intercompany breaks, aged balances, and timing differences on a timely basis.
* Prepare and analyze monthly and yearly variance explanations for income statement and balance sheet accounts, identifying key drivers of fluctuations.
* Recommend improvements to the efficiency of accounting processes and timeliness of deliverables.
* Contribute to and support special projects in order to create a more efficient and controlled environment (e.g. automation, AI\-enabled solutions, ERP implementation, process improvements etc.)

**Who you are:**

* Experience with Oracle, BlackLine and OneStream desired
* 4\+ years of accounting experience, including meaningful experience with intercompany accounting, consolidations, or multinational close processes; experience with a U.S. multinational company or Big 4 accounting firm preferred.
* **Qualified Chartered Accountant preferred.**
* Advanced Excel skills required
* Demonstrated ownership mindset and ability to independently identify, investigate, and resolve issues.
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong analytical skills and sound judgment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams.
* Ability to use data, reporting tools, and automation to improve the accuracy and efficiency of recurring accounting activities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and meet close deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated history of living the values important to priceline.com: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust. Unquestionable integrity and ethics.

**\#LIHybrid**

**Who We Are**
==============

**WE ARE PRICELINE.**


Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding \- we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.


Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown\-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.


We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.


Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.


If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

**Flexible work at Priceline**
==============================


Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

**Perks \& Benefits at Priceline**
==================================


Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

**Health \& wellness coverage** including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

**Generous time off** including PTO, holidays, a company\-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

**Work/life support** including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

**Financial security programs** such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax\-advantaged accounts

**Signature travel perks** including employee\-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

**Additional perks \& discounts** like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

**A people\-first culture** with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*

**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
============================


To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.


Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

**Applying for this position**


We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all **current employees**, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.


External candidates are required to have an account before applying.

title: Sr. Analyst II FP&A
description:
Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+  

employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999,  

Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event  

professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help  

them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people  

together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry  

through innovative technology that powers human connection.  

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone  

and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.  

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like  

entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and  

celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.  

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human  

connection.  

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**  

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At  

Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our  

DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to  

experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll  

thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering  

exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.  

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn,  

iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AIpowered  

collaboration, we’d love to meet you.  

  

**About the Role:**  

We are seeking a strategic, analytically strong FP\&A professional to join our team as an Senior Analyst  

II – FP\&A, supporting Marketing mini\-CFO, in partnering with Cvent's Global Marketing organization —  

spanning Brand, Demand Generation, Events, Digital, Product Marketing, and Regional Field  

Marketing.  

This role sits at the intersection of Marketing and FP\&A. You will be supporting Marketing mini\-CFO to  

drive marketing efficiency and ROI analysis, but you must also deeply understand the \*bookings and  

pipeline world\* — how marketing activity converts into leads, MQLs, SQL, pipeline, and ultimately  

bookings. You will help Marketing and Finance leaders answer the core questions: “what is working,  

what is not working, and where should the next marketing dollar go.”  

In addition to this, the individual would also be required to drive core planning processes such as annual  

budgeting, monthly reforecasting, and cost tracking, while building and interpreting the full marketingto\-  

bookings funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, cost per lead, lead  

conversion by tactic, and marketing ROI by LoB. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen  

with genuine fluency in what a B2B marketing function should deliver, and the drive to translate data  

into clear recommendations for the Marketing organization and senior leaders.  

This role involves frequent interaction with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and Corporate  

Finance teams based in the U.S. and India.


In This Role, You Will::
* Marketing Finance Partnership \& RI (primary focus)


o Act as support to Marketing mini\-CFO to support to the Global Marketing organization,  

partnering with marketing leadership to translate growth strategies, campaign plans, and  

pipeline targets into annual budgets and rolling forecasts.  

o Build, own, and continuously improve the Marketing ROI financial model by LoB —  

connecting spend, activity and outcomes end to end.  

o Develop and track key Marketing efficiency metrics, including:  

* CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
* CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)
* Cost per Lead/MQL (by LoB, by tactic)
* Lead Conversion Rates (by tactic / channel), CTR
* Marketing ROI


o Analyze the full funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, and cost  

per lead — and tie each stage to financial and pipeline outcomes.  

o Drive deep\-dive analytics on event ROI, digital campaigns, tradeshows, and content  

marketing performance.  

o Deliver a clear point of view on what's working and what's not working across marketing  

tactics and channels, with concrete, prioritized recommendations for the marketing  

organization.  

o Build and evaluate business cases for marketing initiatives — campaigns, media  

investments, Martech, and events — using ROI, CAC, payback to guide spend prioritization.  

o Support and advise on resource\-allocation decisions across marketing channels and  

geographies.  

* Bookings \& Pipeline Fluency


o Understand and work fluently with the sales forecasting and bookings process, connecting  

marketing funnel metrics (MQLs, pipeline, bookings influence) to bookings outcomes by LoB.  

o Partner on pipeline\-trend and funnel analysis — conversion rates, sales cycle length, and  

pipeline velocity — to assess how marketing feeds the bookings engine.  

o Align marketing investment views with bookings and pipeline targets so finance tells one  

consistent growth story.  

* Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Work


o Partner with Sales, Marketing Ops, and Data/Analytics teams to ensure consistent, trusted  

measurement frameworks.  

o Create executive\-level dashboards, presentations, and financial insights to support strategic  

initiatives, and present them confidently to non\-financial and senior audiences.  

o Lead or support ad\-hoc strategic projects, including M\&A / acquisition integration and costoptimization  

initiatives.  

o Extract and analyze data using tools like Salesforce, Adaptive Insights, Excel, and other  

analytics platforms.
Here's What You Need::
* 7–10 years of experience in FP\&A, business finance, or a related field.
* Preferred background (either path works): experience in a B2B organization either (a) in


Marketing Data \& ROI Analytics, or (b) in Finance partnering with Marketing — with real  

exposure to marketing funnel dynamics and bookings/pipeline.  

* Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnel metrics, digital campaign dynamics,


channel/tactic\-level ROI, and a clear view of what a B2B marketing function should bring to the  

business.  

* Solid understanding of the bookings and pipeline world — sales forecasting, funnel/conversion


analysis, and how marketing influences bookings  

* Strong data\-driven mindset and the ability to structure and interpret large, imperfect datasets to


generate insights.  

* Expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and metric development — including the ability to


think through a marketing ROI model from first principles.  

* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Adaptive Insights or similar tools preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to non\-financial and senior


stakeholders; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders is strongly preferred.  

* Strong drive, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
* MBA or CFA preferred


Disclaimer:  

Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting  

communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent will  

never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social  

media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications,  

payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.  

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and  

report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.  

For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/noticerecruitment\-  

fraud.

title: Sr Accountant
description:
**About the Role**
  

  

We are looking for a Senior Accountant on the Global Intercompany Team to be part of a team that is critical to the company's month\-end close process and SOX compliance. In this exciting role, you will support the intercompany accounting operations for assigned regions and work cross\-functionally with Finance Engineering and other teams to enhance Uber's internal systems and processes.
  

  

We are looking for this individual to act as a cross\-functional business partner in the on\-shoring and structuring of new legal entities and to support strategic initiatives such as M\&A integrations, including the establishment and ongoing support of intercompany operations resulting from those integrations, as well as IP restructurings and tax initiatives.
  

  

This role requires an individual with strong knowledge of intercompany accounting and multi\-entity structures, as well as a curious and analytical mindset. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys digging into complex topics, asks the right questions, and is resourceful in finding answers rather than waiting for direction. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating ambiguity, investigating issues independently, and proactively identifying solutions and opportunities for improvement.
  

  

The ideal candidate will also embrace AI as part of their day\-to\-day work, continuously exploring how AI and emerging technologies can automate repetitive activities, improve analysis, and create more efficient and scalable accounting processes.
  

  

If a fast\-moving, constantly evolving environment excites you, this could be an excellent opportunity for you!
  

  

**What the Candidate Will Do**
* Own and support key intercompany accounting operations for assigned regions, serving as a primary point of contact for intercompany matters and ensuring accurate and timely execution of related accounting activities.
* Actively participate in the monthly close process, including preparation of reports, flux analysis, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Prepare and review intercompany journal entries in accordance with transfer pricing regulations to ensure a timely monthly, quarterly, and year\-end close.
* Perform FX analysis and clearing for various intercompany transactions, settlements, payments, and collections on behalf.
* Be responsible for global monthly intercompany balances across 250\+ entities, including the netting process, tripartite settlements for intercompany loans, and follow\-up on related queries.
* Investigate and resolve elimination issues and review automated intercompany entries coming from various systems to ensure a smooth consolidation process.
* Set up complex transfer pricing calculations in iCAN (Intercompany Accounting and Netting, our in\-house tool).
* Support M\&A integrations from an intercompany accounting perspective and help establish and support the resulting intercompany operations, including new entities, intercompany relationships, accounting flows, and related activities.
* Participate in strategic accounting projects and initiatives, including IP restructurings, tax initiatives, new revenue standards, and support for new product launches.
* Coordinate the review of intercompany agreements with Regional Tax, Legal, and Compliance teams and maintain intercompany relationships in the global intercompany system.
* Act as a business partner with the Tax Team on on\-shoring entities and changes in tax structures, supporting the implementation of changes relevant to intercompany accounting operations.
* Actively explore and adopt AI\-enabled solutions as part of day\-to\-day activities, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes, enhance analysis, and improve the efficiency and scalability of intercompany accounting operations.
* Proactively investigate complex or unfamiliar intercompany matters, leveraging available data, systems, documentation, and cross\-functional resources to understand root causes and recommend solutions.
* Support process improvement initiatives and system implementations, providing intercompany accounting expertise and assisting with the testing and implementation of process and system enhancements.
* Perform and maintain assigned internal controls and support critical ad\-hoc analysis and projects as needed.
* Collaborate with key cross\-functional partners, including Finance, Engineering, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Internal Audit, and other teams on a variety of initiatives.
* Manage outsourced GBS/accounting support teams where needed.

**What the Candidate Will Need**
* 6\+ years of relevant accounting experience, with knowledge of intercompany accounting, transfer pricing, consolidation, and accounting in a multi\-entity environment.
* Strong understanding of fundamental accounting concepts and US GAAP, including foreign currency (FX), intercompany eliminations, and financial reporting requirements in an international environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex accounting matters, identify root causes, and independently develop potential solutions.
* A curious and proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing responsibilities, and manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong communication and business partnering skills, with the ability to clearly communicate accounting matters, risks, issues, and status updates to both accounting and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and proficiency with data analysis tools such as Microsoft Excel; experience with SQL or other data analysis tools is a plus.
* Interest in leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve day\-to\-day accounting activities, analysis, and operational efficiency.

**Bonus Points**
* Experience with Oracle ERP environments and intercompany accounting systems; experience with Oracle Fusion is a plus.
* Experience with FCCS (Financial Consolidation and Close) or similar financial consolidation platforms.
* Experience supporting ERP implementations, system migrations, testing, or finance transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with global intercompany operations, transfer pricing models, or complex legal entity structures.
Experience supporting M\&A integrations, entity restructurings, or tax\-driven initiatives from an accounting perspective  
* 

  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  

**About the Role:**



We’re looking for a high\-energy, hands\-on Senior Revenue Accountant who has significant experience with reviewing B2B SaaS sales contracts, managing appropriate revenue recognition in accordance with ASC 606, and participating in day\-to\-day billing and revenue accounting activities. The ideal candidate thinks strategically on a process level and also executes in the details. They are comfortable using core systems and tools and think automation first when designing process. Join our small but driven and expanding team to help build the processes and procedures that will support JumpCloud as we continue to expand globally.



### **What you’ll be doing:**

* Review B2B SaaS sales contracts to ensure 100% compliance with ASC 606 (or relevant revenue recognition standards) for all revenue transactions.
* Review and execute Sales Orders, billing transactions and revenue schedules
* Apply revenue recognition policies to complex contracts and issues.
* Proactively identify and implement additional controls or reconciliations needed within the Q2C process.
* Develop and execute reconciliations for areas identified as needing additional controls or tie\-outs.
* Maintain a near\-zero error rate in revenue\-related transactions, approvals, and reconciliations.
* Complete all revenue\-related close tasks within established deadlines, consistently.
* Produce accurate and timely revenue reports for management review.
* Identify and assist in implementing efficiencies to minimize month\-end close time.
* Prepare monthly revenue and reclassification journal entries.
* Conduct monthly revenue flux analysis and miscellaneous revenue adjustments as needed.
* Maintain all transaction support records and documentation in an organized and audit\-ready state.
* Coordinate efforts to gather documentation and reporting for auditors.
* Participate and contribute to audit walkthroughs and ad\-hoc discussions.
* Assist in ensuring SOX compliance regarding revenue\-related controls.
* Demonstrate or develop proficiency in SFDC, with the ability to extract necessary data in the form of basic to moderately complex reports.
* Demonstrate or develop proficiency in NetSuite, including the ability to extract necessary data for reports and saved searches with limited support.
* Demonstrate or develop an understanding of the Advanced Revenue Module (ARM) in NetSuite to trace revenue transactions from transaction documents to the general ledger.
* Assist in identifying and troubleshooting system\-related revenue accounting issues.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and other departments.
* Recognize and effectively communicate the cross\-functional impacts of accounting projects, changes, or discoveries.
* Effectively communicate revenue accounting requirements to non\-financial stakeholders.
* Work with sales teams to ensure contracts are structured to allow for scalable processing and proper revenue recognition.
* Identify and assist in implementing process improvements, particularly automation and AI enabled processes, to enhance efficiency, scalability, and accuracy in revenue accounting.
* Develop and maintain up\-to\-date documentation on revenue accounting policies and procedures.
* Provide insightful analysis of revenue trends and variances.
* Develop and maintain key reconciliations to ensure complete and accurate revenue accounting and ARR reporting on a monthly basis.
* Maintain a deep understanding of current and evolving revenue recognition standards.
* Participate in relevant professional development activities.
* Take an active role in researching and documenting changes to company revenue recognition accounting policies.
* Maintain a positive, professional, and constructive tone in all communications.
### **Preferred Qualifications:**


* BS/BA degree in Accounting or Finance.
* CPA (or similar) preferred.
